chunks: As recompense for all they had done.

key_terms.يَعْمَلُونَ: They used to do / they were doing

ai.seo_question: What is the recompense for the disbelievers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the principle of 'Jaza' al-Amal' (recompense of the deed), emphasizing that divine punishment is not arbitrary but a precise, intrinsic consequence of the disbelievers' own choices. It highlights the justice of Allah, where the punishment fits the crime, serving as a deterrent and a testament to the causal link between worldly actions and eternal outcomes.
